episodes.title: Everything Is Fine
episodes.summary: Thanks to some kind of error, Eleanor Shellstrop, an ordinary woman, enters the afterlife and is sent to the Good Place -- which is definitely not where she belongs. While hiding in plain sight from Michael, the wise architect of the Good Place who is unaware that he's made a mistake, she's determined to shed her old way of living and discover the awesome person within. Helping Eleanor navigate her new surroundings are Chidi, her kind, open-hearted "soulmate" who sees the good in people but finds himself facing quite a dilemma; her frustratingly perfect new neighbors, Tahani and Jianyu; and Janet, a walking, talking source for all the knowledge in the universe.

episodes.title: Flying
episodes.summary: Eleanor tries to prove to Chidi that she is worthy of his help. Meanwhile, Tahani and Jianyu try to help Michael feel better about the unknown flaw in his Neighborhood.

episodes.title: Tahani Al-Jamil
episodes.summary: Chidi begins formally teaching Eleanor about ethics, and lesson No. 1 is: be kind to your neighbor. Michael and Janet help Chidi find a new, exciting hobby.

episodes.title: Jason Mendoza
episodes.summary: Eleanor faces her toughest test yet in her attempt to remain in hiding. Meanwhile, Michael enlists Tahani to help a fellow neighbor fulfill her true purpose.

episodes.title: Category 55 Emergency Doomsday Crisis
episodes.summary: Eleanor's eagerness to learn ethics from Chidi becomes the full-time job he never wanted. Meanwhile, Michael and Janet focus their attention on a Neighborhood emergency.

episodes.title: What We Owe to Each Other
episodes.summary: Eleanor is enlisted to help Michael with an important task that could determine her fate in the Good Place. Meanwhile, Chidi agrees to be the third wheel in an effort to help out his friend.

episodes.title: The Eternal Shriek
episodes.summary: Eleanor and Chidi set off on a quest with Janet as their guide. Meanwhile, Tahani attempts to show Michael how much he is appreciated.

episodes.title: Most Improved Player
episodes.summary: Michael has a private meeting with Eleanor. Meanwhile, Chidi, who has been harboring a secret, contemplates what to do.

episodes.title: ...Someone Like Me as a Member
episodes.summary: Michael's skills are put to the test when he attempts to sort out an unprecedented situation. Meanwhile, Chidi makes a connection elsewhere, much to the dismay of Eleanor, while Janet shows a different side of herself.

episodes.title: Chidi's Choice
episodes.summary: Eleanor makes a surprising personal discovery. Meanwhile, Michael tasks an indecisive Chidi with coming to an important decision and Jianyu makes a big announcement.

episodes.title: What's My Motivation
episodes.summary: Eleanor and Tahani hatch a plan while Michael makes a startling discovery. Meanwhile, Chidi confides in Eleanor after learning some interesting news.

episodes.title: Mindy St. Claire
episodes.summary: With the help of Chidi and Tahani, Michael faces his biggest challenge yet. Meanwhile, Eleanor, Jianyu and Janet are faced with a monumental decision.

episodes.title: Michael's Gambit
episodes.summary: Eleanor and her friends contemplate their fates in the Good Place.

episodes.title: Everything Is Great! Part 1
episodes.summary: Having had their memories erased by ambitious master architect Michael, Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani and Jason again settle into the Good Place, unaware of what has previously transpired...except that Eleanor discovers the one clue she had left for herself and attempts to piece things together.

episodes.title: Everything Is Great! Part 2
episodes.summary: Their memories erased, Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani, and Jason once again settle into the Good Place, unaware of what has previously transpired; Eleanor attempts to piece things together using a clue she left for herself.

episodes.title: Dance Dance Resolution
episodes.summary: Michael continues to work out the kinks in his grand plan. Meanwhile, Eleanor stumbles across a secret.

episodes.title: Team Cockroach
episodes.summary: Michael approaches things from a new angle. Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani and Jason struggle to make a collective decision.

episodes.title: Existential Crisis
episodes.summary: Tahani throws a dinner party to impress. Eleanor and Jason both have to lend a hand when things don't go as planned.

episodes.title: The Trolley Problem
episodes.summary: Chidi and Eleanor tackle a famous ethical dilemma, leading to a conflict with Michael. Meanwhile, Tahani harbors a secret and confides in Janet.

episodes.title: Janet and Michael
episodes.summary: When the Neighborhood experiences a small glitch, Michael has to resolve the issue with Janet before it gets out of control.

episodes.title: Derek
episodes.summary: Janet creates a big problem for Michael. Meanwhile, Eleanor lets Chidi in on a secret, and Jason puts Tahani in a difficult position.

episodes.title: Leap to Faith
episodes.summary: Michael receives a surprise visitor. Meanwhile, Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani and Jason attempt to solve a riddle.

episodes.title: Best Self
episodes.summary: Michael finds himself in a bind. Meanwhile, Eleanor sparks an idea that has Chidi, Tahani, Jason and even Janet laying their feelings on the line.

episodes.title: Rhonda, Diana, Jake, and Trent
episodes.summary: Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani, Janet and Jason head to a destination that may have lasting implications.

episodes.title: The Burrito
episodes.summary: Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani and Jason consider just how much they have (or have not) improved. Michael is left to deal with the consequences of his recent actions.

episodes.title: Somewhere Else
episodes.summary: Michael tries to pull a rabbit out of a hat.

episodes.title: Everything Is Bonzer! Part 1
episodes.summary: In the season premiere, Michael returns to Earth to give Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani and Jason a little nudge in the right direction when their initial attempts to become better people falter.

episodes.title: Everything Is Bonzer! Part 2
episodes.summary: Michael intervenes in the near-death accidents of Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani and Jason on Earth, in hopes that a second chance at life allows them to become better versions of themselves.

episodes.title: The Brainy Bunch
episodes.summary: Intent on wrecking Michael's plans, Trevor shows up on Earth to join Chidi's study and annoy the gang into breaking up.

episodes.title: The Snowplow
episodes.summary: A surprising announcement from one of the humans threatens to dissolve the group.

episodes.title: Jeremy Bearimy
episodes.summary: The group explores the three main branches of ethical thought.

episodes.title: The Ballad of Donkey Doug
episodes.summary: Jason visits with some people from his past while Chidi gets help in resolving a problem.

episodes.title: A Fractured Inheritance
episodes.summary: Eleanor makes a startling discovery that tests her resolve, Tahani looks to make amends and Janet does some bonding.

episodes.title: The Worst Possible Use of Free Will
episodes.summary: Eleanor looks back on some forgotten moments from her past.

episodes.title: Don't Let the Good Life Pass You By
episodes.summary: Michael and Janet visit the person they believe to be the blueprint for how to live a good life on Earth, and Eleanor turns to Tahani for advice.

episodes.title: Janet(s)
episodes.summary: With Janet's help, Michael hatches a plan.

episodes.title: The Book of Dougs
episodes.summary: Michael's resolve is put to the test. Meanwhile, Jason wrestles with his feelings and Chidi surprises Eleanor.

episodes.title: Chidi Sees the Time-Knife
episodes.summary: Michael arranges an important meeting and Janet makes a reconnection.

episodes.title: Pandemonium
episodes.summary: Various events occur, in a certain specific order.

episodes.title: A Girl from Arizona
episodes.summary: With Eleanor assuming the role of the architect, the group adapts to the challenges facing them when four test subjects inhabit a new neighborhood under their supervision.

episodes.title: A Girl from Arizona Part 2
episodes.summary: Eleanor, Michael, Janet and Tahani have their hands full when the new residents begin to show their true colors. Jason receives some unsettling news.

episodes.title: Chillaxing
episodes.summary: Michael and Eleanor discover something troubling and turn to an unusual source for help; Tahani lends her expertise to assist with one of the new residents.

episodes.title: Tinker, Tailor, Demon, Spy
episodes.summary: Uncertainty abounds when an unexpected visitor arrives.

episodes.title: Employee of the Bearimy
episodes.summary: Michael and Jason hatch a plan. Eleanor learns firsthand the difficulties of running the neighborhood.

episodes.title: A Chip Driver Mystery
episodes.summary: One of the new residents creates a division in the ranks.

episodes.title: Help Is Other People
episodes.summary: On the last day of the experiment, Chidi is faced with one final ethical dilemma.

episodes.title: The Funerals To End All Funerals
episodes.summary: The group awaits the judge's final decision on the fate of human existence.

episodes.title: The Answer
episodes.summary: In an attempt to plan a better future, Chidi considers his past.

episodes.title: You've Changed, Man
episodes.summary: The group works to negotiate an afterlife plan with Sean and the judge.

episodes.title: Mondays, Am I Right?
episodes.summary: Michael runs some tests and Chidi gets some good advice from Jason.

episodes.title: Patty
episodes.summary: The group makes some new friends.

episodes.title: Whenever You're Ready
episodes.summary: Various conversations occur, between various groups of people.
